name: Kou 2 → Shougun
source:
Kou 2 Shougun is a mix between 2 different kind of games a dating simulation first person adventure game and a first person perspective adventure sound novel.

The game begins in the year 2001, where the player takes the role of a young high school student. Hwill have to decide what to do each week and how to react to different questions that the girls of his high school will ask him, this part of the game got also some exams that will increase the character stats and will also affect his relationship with the girls.

But when the player reach a certain part of the game (year 2003 or so) he will find some kind of time hole and will be taken to the medieval Japan. The game changes to a first person perspective sound novel, and in this part the player can only choose between different answers to make the history advance in a way or another.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/K/SLPS-02955.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
Kou 2 Shogun是两种不同类型游戏的混合体：约会模拟第一人称冒险游戏和第一人称视角冒险声音小说。

游戏开始于2001年，玩家扮演一名年轻的高中生。他必须决定每周做什么，以及如何应对高中女生会问他的不同问题，这部分游戏还进行了一些考试，这些考试会增加角色统计数据，也会影响他与女孩的关系。

但当玩家到达游戏的某个部分（2003年左右）时，他会发现某种时间漏洞，并被带到中世纪的日本。游戏改为第一人称视角，听起来很新颖，在这部分玩家只能在不同的答案之间进行选择，以使历史以某种方式前进。

[来自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/K/SLPS-02955.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
